steps: Start the Tutorial from the main menu.
Complete every Tutorial objective through to the end — the achievement unlocks automatically.
Enter the Tutorial (do not skip it).
Find the character named Kristopher during the Tutorial sequence.
Melee-punch Kristopher once — the secret achievement unlocks immediately.
warnings: Missable if you skip or rush past Kristopher in the Tutorial — you will need to replay the Tutorial later just for this punch.

achievements.name: Ricochet
achievements.description: Kill an enemy player with a ricochet bullet

steps: In a multiplayer match, aim at solid cover (walls, buildings, rocks) at a shallow angle near an enemy.
Fire so the bullet bounces off the surface and kills the enemy — sniper ricochets off buildings also count if the kill is from the bounce.

achievements.name: Long Shot
achievements.description: Get a kill from over 950m away

steps: Progress the Recon branch and equip a reliable sniper loadout.
Find a clear open sightline of 950m+ (bridges and long valleys work well).
Engage a spotted target and secure the kill while standing more than 950 meters away.

achievements.name: Do Not Resuscitate
achievements.description: Kill an enemy player using the defibrillator charge

steps: Level the Medic track to Level 11, then spend $50,000 to unlock the Defibrillator.
Buy a Defibrillator ($1,600, 2.6 kg) and a battery so it can charge.
Get into close range of an enemy (corners/cover help) and hit them with the electrical discharge to kill them.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: There are no fixed roles — medic XP from revives/heals unlocks defibs; anyone can buy them once unlocked.

achievements.name: Fat Stacks
achievements.description: Reach $100,000 net profit in a single life

steps: Stay alive for a long profitable life — dying resets the single-life counter.
Stack income from Recon spotting (mark + assist cash when teammates kill spotted enemies), building useful structures, and helicopter supply transport.
Reach $100,000 net profit before you die once.

achievements.name: Top Dog
achievements.description: Finish the match as the top cash earner across all teams

steps: Play the full match focused on cash: objectives, spotting, builds, revives/heals with defibrillators and large batteries.
Stay alive and keep earning through the end — you must finish #1 cash earner across all three teams.
Bank a large cash pile first (often right after unlocking Fat Stacks in the same life).
In one purchase, equip the most expensive loadout you can until the single loadout spend hits $100,000.
warnings: Rarest achievement (~0.1% global) — you need both a huge cash reserve and a single purchase that clears $100k.

achievements.name: CZ Survivor
achievements.description: Spend 60 minutes in the CZ without dying

steps: Enter the Control Zone (CZ) and stay inside it.
Play from cover with your team — avoid being the first into every fight and skip unnecessary duels.
Accumulate 60 continuous minutes in the CZ without dying once.
warnings: Any death resets the timer — treat this as a patience run, not a frag chase.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.description: Win a match without another team scoring a point

steps: Queue with an organized squad or wait for a strong coordinated team.
Dominate CZ/objective control so neither of the other two teams scores a single point.
Win the match with the shutout intact.
warnings: Not realistically soloable — one slip that lets another team score voids the run.
